scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Treatment of Chronic Diseases (HBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Must be registered under the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Must have a regular membership for at least one year
Must have a minimum of 90 days work experience in the preceding year to avail benefits
Application can be submitted only once
Must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID) for verification; if missing, obtain it from the PPP portal
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹1,00,000 for indoor treatment of chronic diseases such as Cancer, TB, AIDS.
